start.prompt: work items / slugs from user message

describe.prompt: output path (Nicki-owned; usually worktree current-task/story.md), task id, chat

spec.prompt: output path (Nicki-owned; usually worktree specs/<slug>.json), task id, chat

subtasks.prompt: output path (Nicki-owned; usually worktree subtasks/<slug>.md), task id, chat

archive.prompt: prefix (workspace or nested-project root), slug; archive_dir is always <prefix>/docs/archive/<slug>/; status/artifact paths or source_document; optional errors path; task id

sheep_return_contract.description: Every sheep ends with compact JSON. Nicki forwards the return plus --step/--mode to sheep-status. Sheep do not name pipeline position — update-status derives next_step from routing, or from summary next_step when Nicki supplies one (e.g. after review).
sheep_return_contract.on_blocked: set completed_status to blocked; populate open_questions

harness_failure.prompt: worktree path, failed script route, script input, expected output contract, actual failure context, blocked pipeline step

update-status.py.notes: Nicki passes --step and --mode. next_step from routing, or summary next_step when Nicki sets it. Position-only writes need summary next_step. Missing required field → written false.
